nodes.label: ShaderProgram.SetUint requirement
nodes.rationale: SetInt on a uint uniform is a GL error, value stays 0, and an indirect dispatch sized from it hangs the GPU.

nodes.label: VFX shared counter pool (CounterBuffer, 64 uint per system)
nodes.rationale: Layout is defined in three places that must stay in sync: VfxCodegen.Counter*, VFX_C_* in VfxCommon.glsl, C_* in VfxFrame.shader.
nodes.norm_label: vfx shared counter pool (counterbuffer, 64 uint per system)

nodes.label: VFX frame flow (VfxSimulationPass, VfxRuntime.RunSimulation)
nodes.rationale: All queued effects are packed into one uniform buffer and dispatched in phases with one barrier per phase to cut barriers.

nodes.label: Generated GLSL reserved word restrictions
nodes.rationale: Words like active, half, output, input, filter, sample, common, partition fail to compile on NVIDIA.
